hooks.command: root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; lock="$root/.git/index.lock"; [ -f "$lock" ] && ! lsof "$lock" >/dev/null 2>&1 && rm -f "$lock"; exit 0

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git push.*(origin )?(main|master)'; then echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"Direct push to main/master is not allowed. Create a branch and open a PR instead."}'; exit 2; fi
